reviews.x: With this being the 3rd pack that I have purchased; from 3 different companies, this is the worse.  Not only were a few items defective, the entire package was dirty.  I found hair, bits of paper and dirt on a few of f the rollers.  8/9 items show above have pin prick size holes at the top.  Every time the item is used the hole is stretched and the hole is enlarged.  The items are great, which is why I have purchased more than one, but this company is not the one for my family and I.

My daughter loves her hair with this curlers in. I'm an amateur and I dont do hair. I put these in my daughter's hair and let it stay for 24 hours. Came out cute. Now she wants me to put it  every weekend. It lasts a week for school. I haven't had her sit under a dryer yet. Will try that next. My daughter never had any chemicals in her hair. Her hair is not straightened in the picture. Just washed it with natural products and used a setting lotion.

These are awesome!! My hair is 4c texture and it takes a long time to dry. But I was extremely happy with how comfortable these are to sleep in. And my curls were really tight. My next go around will be on dry hair and I hope for another great turnout if not better. I will probably order another set because I prefer the smaller ones vs the larger ones.

I love how these curlers work, they make beautiful waves and curls. You do have to leave them in for more than 8 hours for the best results, and it your hair is wet at the time of installing them, allow 10 to 12 hours. Make sure your hair is not soak and wet. They are not the most comfortable to sleep in.

reviews.t: Works well on dry hair only!
reviews.x: These are great BUT you must make sure your hair is totally dry or they will not work. The first time I tried them my hair was just a tiny bit damp- I slept in them and it was still a total fail. I used them again the next night on completely dry hair and they worked great!

These rollers are the best thing since natural hair!! 🎉 they are easy to apply. They dry over night (when I only use design essentials moose). I’ve been getting so many compliments. I have ordered more for my clients to use in the future.

These rollers are just what I was looking for.  They are easy to use, are comfortable to sleep on and give a nice curl.  They require a little bit of practice to get them to lay flat but after that they are great.
these were way better than anticipated. I'm happy I didn't listen to the reviews. I have long dreads and they curled better-than-expected. I would most definitely buy again

reviews.x: What an awful product! They DO NOT stay in place! Poor design does not allow for a good grip OR decent airflow to actually let your hair dry. I have thick, coarse hair that will hold the most complicated styles and keep every other curling product in place, but these slid out repeatedly - EVEN with mousse AND hairspray on damp (not WET) hair. They just kept slipping down. Did I mention that my hair is right at my collarbones  in length? So, it’s not like I was trying to use these on waist-length

These I put in my hair as tightly as I can and they immediately start unrolling the first inch, then the hair continues to unravel so they either fall out or hang so it's only the very ends of my hair in them. These do not work if you have long hair or thick hair. You have to use very little hair for each one. They kept coming undone and my hair didn’t curl after leaving them in all night.  But it may just be that my hair is too long and thick. Maybe if you have thinner shorter hair it’ll work

The rollers came on time.  I used them that night and they seemed to work fine for my hair.  I don’t think I could sleep in them as others have mentioned.  They rollers however didn’t work so well on my granddaughter’s hair.  We are going  to try again misting her hair with water and then rolling it.  I am still happy with my purchase.

good value the best that I found so far online there are 48 pieces and the cost of the 48 pieces where is relatively cheaper than anything that has less than that there are two sizes and once I figured out how to use them that was easy to use their comfortable and they leave a nice curl.

I’ve done a test run with a dry lock of hair. It works!  Didn’t slip out and remained close to my scalp. I’m looking to add more ways to style my natural 4c hair, and I believe these will work out well.
Pretty durable and much easier to sleep in than the curl rods. Awesome value for the money. I do suggest watching some YouTube tutorials if u dont know how to use these things.

reviews.t: Best used under a head drying machine.
reviews.x: Great stuff, however, didn’t really dry my hair as much I left it on for 24 hours and my hair was still a little wet so I think it’s best used under a head drying machine.

reviews.x: There were supposed to be 48 pieces but there are only 34..... Only 11 large ones..  Very unsatisfied

I wouldn't waste your time or money they don't stay in your hair

claims.text: Many reviewers find the rollers comfortable to sleep in and easy to use, producing nice curls.
Several reviewers report the rollers slip out or come undone, especially on thick, coarse, or long hair.
Results depend heavily on hair being completely dry; damp or wet hair leads to failure.
Some reviewers praise the value, noting the large 48-piece set and durability for the price.
A few reviewers received defective or dirty items, including holes and debris on the rollers.
